events.verdict: Adebayo (MIA) places both hands on Harris (DET) as he sets the screen and releases but the contact is marginal.
Highsmith (MIA) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Highsmith (MIA) and Cunningham (DET) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Robinson (MIA) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Ivey's (DET) path and is dislodged from his position as a result of the contact.
Beasley (DET) places an arm across Robinson's (MIA) front and Robinson briefly grasps his arm in response but the contact between the two players dissolves quickly.
Robinson (MIA) lowers his arm as he contests Stewart's (DET) drive to the basket and the contact with his arm during the pass is marginal.
Ivey (DET) dives for the loose ball and initiates contact to Rozier's (MIA) lower body that causes him to lose his balance.
Beasley (DET) briefly engages with Herro (MIA) off ball, but the contact does not affect his FOM.
Herro (MIA) loses control of the ball on his own and when Ivey (DET) reaches in for the loose ball, the contract with Herro's arm is incidental.
Ivey (DET) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Ivey's (DET) drive to the basket and the contact is created by Ivey veering into him.
Although Herro (MIA) makes contact with the ball, he initiates illegal contact across Duren's (DET) arm in order to get to the ball and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Duren (DET) avoids making contact with Robinson's (MIA) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Ivey (DET) initiates contact across Adebayo's (MIA) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Adebayo (MIA) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Fontecchio (DET) makes contact with the ball and incidental contact with Adebayo's (MIA) hand on the ball.
Rozier (MIA) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Stewart (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in Rozier's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Highsmith (MIA) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Cunningham's (DET) wrist before cleanly dislodging the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) holds down Cunningham's (DET) arm, affecting his ability to pursue the jump ball.
Beasley (DET) has a hand placed against Herro's (MIA) body but the marginal contact does not affect his driving shot attempt.

MIA requests a timeout when they have none remaining. A technical foul was correctly assessed, and the ball then awarded to DET following their free throw attempt. Miami should also have been awarded the timeout.
Highsmith (MIA) commits a take foul on Beasley (DET).
